arguments.command:
ls -la && python -c "
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_excel('budget.xlsx')
print(df.to_string())
"

python -c "
from openpyxl import load_workbook
wb = load_workbook('budget.xlsx')
ws = wb.active
print('Sheet name:', ws.title)
print('Dimensions:', ws.dimensions)
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=1, max_row=25, max_col=3):
    for cell in row:
        if cell.value is not None:
            print(f'{cell.coordinate}: {repr(cell.value)}')
"

python -c "
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_excel('budget.xlsx', header=None)
# Expenses are in rows 11-22 (1-indexed -> 0-indexed rows 10-21), col C is index 2
exp = df.iloc[10:22, [0, 1, 2]]
exp.columns = ['Category', 'Item', 'Amount']
exp['Amount'] = pd.to_numeric(exp['Amount'], errors='coerce')
print(exp.to_string(index=False))
print()
print('Total Expenses:', exp['Amount'].sum())
print()
print('By category:')
print(exp.groupby('Category')['Amount'].sum().to_string())
"
